sources.snippet: 🧩 Lumos consists of planning, grounding, and execution modules built based on LLAMA-2-7B and off-the-shelf APIs. 🤗 Lumos utilizes a unified data format that encompasses multiple task types, thereby enabling the developed agent framework to conveniently support a range of interactive tasks.
